_comment: Hand-labelled live reference pages for the privacy findings (#873). Labels were written on 2026-11-03 from the raw first-visit capture of each page (frozen in reference_captures.json) and checked independently against the served HTML, the page JavaScript, the provider documentation and, where a policy label depends on it, a reading of the linked page. The labels are closed-world within checks_labelled: every finding of a labelled check that is not listed in expected is a false positive, every expected entry the tool misses is a false negative. Keys in unlabelled are not scored (reason given). outside_ruleset lists trackers a person identified that no provider list entry covers - reported as list/blind-spot coverage, never as a miss of the rules. Frozen captures keep every request, cookie and storage key as observed, except: anchors that cannot match the policy-link words keep only host and first path segment and the first 24 characters of their text (the rules read only the matching ones; the rest carried article and playlist identifiers), and three storage-key names that tripped the secret scanner of the repository were shortened or lower-cased (heise.de: a public client key dropped from `ta_bot_protection_config*`; w3schools.com: `fastCMP-*` -> `fastcmp-*`); none of them is classified or decides a label. Labels are never changed to follow the tool: a page that changed is re-labelled from a fresh raw capture (scripts/privacy-reference.py).
